title: Reject nested schema resource identities that shadow indexed material
trigger: Index a support URI as false, then embed a nested $id with the same URI and type:object in the evidence schema and reference that URI.
observed: CatalogSnapshot::from_parts succeeds; schema_bytes(support) returns false, yet validate_structural passes an evidence object using the nested resource.
impact: The exact admitted URI-to-material mapping is not authoritative during validation. This concerns inconsistent trusted catalog content, not an untrusted-instance takeover.
recommendation: Detect conflicting schema resource identities across indexed roots and nested schema resources before admitting/compiling the snapshot; preserve legitimate non-conflicting bundling.

title: Omit absent optional catalog dates when serializing
trigger: Admit the committed catalog index, serialize the CatalogIndex, then re-admit it with unchanged material.
observed: Serialization emits end_of_life_date:null for every entry whose date was omitted; re-admission rejects the output because the property requires a string.
impact: The public catalog Serialize implementation produces schema-invalid bytes from the delivered valid catalog, breaking write/round-trip consumers.

title: Check ambiguous duplicate core fields below the document root
observed: validate_structural returns Pass, while serde_json::from_slice::<BehavioralContract> on the identical original bytes rejects duplicate field call_site.
impact: The root-only duplicate guard leaves nested core data subject to last-value-wins interpretation and structural success is inconsistent with the typed document parser. This is not an acceptance or demonstrated authority bypass.
recommendation: Apply duplicate-aware checking at nested core-object boundaries without reconstructing or losing opaque extension-value bytes; add a validator/decoder consistency regression.

title: Address fidelity failures with the operation array index
trigger: The first upload_object operation declares full, but its correctly resolved contract has an adaptation-required obligation.
observed: The error path is operations["upload_object"].behavioral_fidelity, although operations is a Vec and the actual path is operations[0].behavioral_fidelity.
impact: Tools and IDE consumers cannot navigate the reported field; the current fidelity test asserts this incorrect path.
recommendation: Enumerate operations and emit the numerical index; retain the operation identity in safe descriptive context.

title: Retain referenced-document identity and path in resolution failures
trigger: A referenced stored contract has a matching hash and identity but is missing operation_identity.
observed: Its Structural diagnostic becomes pack-scoped contracts.upload_object.operation_identity with a generic Required field is missing description. That field cannot exist on ContractRef, and original document identity/version are overwritten.
impact: The consumer cannot identify the contract field needing repair. The same remapping exists for unsupported/orphan references in manifest/validator.rs:69-75.
recommendation: Keep the original referenced-document diagnostic, or point to the actual manifest .id reference and explicitly retain the referenced location in structured/safe context.
